items.description: Leak detection and bathroom wall opening
items.rationale: Clause 1.1 covers escape from the split internal supply pipe, and clause 2.1 covers locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at €95 gross per hour give €190.

items.description: Replacement of split 15 mm copper pipe section
items.rationale: Clause 2.2 covers replacement of the fractured section, including the necessary fittings. Allow €225 gross for the local repair, excluding the access work billed separately.

items.description: Wall closure, plastering and retiling of 0.2 m² patch
items.rationale: Clauses 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their previous condition. Allow €250 gross for labour and materials for the small patch only, with no allowance for undamaged areas.
Clause 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, and this work was unrelated to the leak. The covered amount is €0; €200 is the conditional gross estimate only.
